1.w: Why do the nations rage, and the peoples plot in vain?

2.w: The kings of the earth take their stand, and the rulers establish themselves together against YHWH and against His Anointed:

3.w: “Let us tear off their bonds, and cast away from us their cords.”

4.w: The One sitting in the heavens laughs; the Lord scoffs at them.

5.w: Then He speaks to them in His anger, and in his fury He terrifies them:

6.w: “And I have installed My King on Zion, the mountain of My holiness.”

7.w: I will recount the decree of YHWH; He has said to Me: “You [are] My Son; today I have begotten You.

8.w: Ask from Me and I will give the nations [as] Your inheritance, and the ends of the earth [for] Your possession.

9.w: You will break them with a rod of iron; You will shatter them like a vessel of a potter.”

10.w: And now, O kings, be prudent; be admonished, O judges of the earth.

11.w: Serve YHWH with fear, and rejoice with trembling.

12.w: Kiss the Son, lest He be angry, and you⁺ perish [in] the way, when His wrath is kindled in an instant. Blessed [are] all those taking refuge in Him.
